newsitem.title: UK: Albert Fisher gains after results.
newsitem.headline: Albert Fisher gains after results.

text.p: Shares in Albert Fisher Group Plc climbed on Thursday after the British food processing and distribution company reported higher earnings and turnover.

Albert Fisher shares were up 3-1/4p at 42-3/4p in early afternoon dealing, with almost 23 million shares traded. "The figures were bang in line with expectations and there have been some favourable comments from today's analysts' meeting," one marketmaker said.

Albert Fisher said pretax profit rose to 40.1 million stg in the year to August 31 from 39.5 million a year earlier. But an exceptional 15l million stg charge on disposals left the company with a loss for the latest year.
